info.name: EchoEnglish recommendation platform
info.description:
Every recommendation-platform endpoint, ordered as a client would call them, with tests on each request.

**Sandbox (no setup):** run `npm run recsys:sandbox`, select the *EchoEnglish recsys - sandbox* environment and run the whole collection (folder 0 skips itself).

**Local app:** select *EchoEnglish recsys - local app*, fill in two test accounts (a learner and an admin) and run the whole collection. The `[sandbox]` requests skip themselves; the app scheduler runs the ETL every 2 minutes, so personalised results appear after the next tick.

Guide: `docs/recommendation/DEVELOPER-GUIDE.md`. A unit test (`__tests__/unit/recsys/postmanCollection.unit.test.ts`) fails when a route is added without a request here.

item.description: The client journey: consent, cold start, events, recommendations, feedback. Requests save what the next one needs (`recId`, item type and ref) in collection variables, so run them in order. In the sandbox, the first request creates a fresh learner each run.
